claims_extracted: The strategy implements Supertrend direction changes with volatility-adaptive stop sizing on 1h BTC data.
The mechanism is trend-following with realized-volatility adaptation, not RSI mean reversion, London breakout, gold momentum, GBPJPY sweep/reversion, or BB-width squeeze.
BTCUSD appears in the FTMO terminal universe snapshot/inventory, making the hypothesis MT5/FTMO-relevant while current Binance BTCUSDT data remains an unverified proxy.

Pre-result mechanical runtime-feasibility repair: the canonical VOL_ADAPTIVE_TREND route uses 150 trials on BTC H1, and the immediately prior BTC H1 Phase 8D 150-trial screening route timed out after 1800000ms before accepted WFA outputs. This attempt preserves the hypothesis, strategy source, parameter space, data source, and costs but uses a Phase 8D-specific 25-trial config before any performance result is known.
limitations: Source support is repo-local implementation/config/data plus terminal-universe evidence, not independent external alpha research.
The Binance BTCUSDT research CSV is proxy data and is not proven equivalent to FTMO BTCUSD terminal history.
Crypto CFD spreads, weekend handling, swaps, symbol contract details, and broker-specific history can materially alter MT5 parity.
The strategy computes a volatility scale internally, but the current signal interface does not separately emit position sizing as deployment-proximate evidence.
disconfirming_relevance: Supertrend flips can whipsaw in sideways crypto regimes after fees and slippage.
A trend-following route can fail positive-window consistency even when aggregate return is positive.
A structurally plausible setup still fails if WFA return, trade count, or OOS consistency floors are not met.
